Yes, this matches my intent. I marked the pasta bookmark as read, it dropped out of the read-later list, and when I switched to "All bookmarks" it was still sitting there in my collection. That's exactly what I wanted — marking something read just clears it off the "get back to this" list, it doesn't delete the bookmark.

And your interpretation is right: I wasn't asking for a separate reading-history log of everything I've ever read. To me "mark as read" simply means "I've dealt with this, take it off my read-later list." That's all I need. This closes the loop on the note I'd been carrying. Good to continue.
